id: \bLong have I waited for the perfect Greninja to appear.
en: \bLong have I waited for the perfect Greninja to appear.
it: \bHo atteso a lungo che comparisse il Greninja perfetto.

id: \bThat one! That's the one! Let me unlock its full potential right now! Just know that it won't be able to breed anymore.
en: \bThat one! That's the one! Let me unlock its full potential right now! Just know that it won't be able to breed anymore.
it: \bQuello! È proprio lui! Lascia che sblocchi subito tutto il suo potenziale! Sappi solo che non potrà più riprodursi.

id: Greninja's ability changed to Battle Bond!\se[increase]
